note: District level only. A film resolves to a district only where the film or its catalog record names the place; 'provisional' marks a district the author infers and has not yet confirmed from the film. Off-map films are listed, not drawn. Extras are films not yet in the catalog.

institutions.name: Dr. Ram Dayal Munda Tribal Welfare Research Institute (TRI)
institutions.role: The Jharkhand government's tribal research institute commissioned Akhra's festival films Karam and Sohrai and Biju Toppo's Tapu Rajee, holds screenings in its hall in Ranchi, and in 2025 began the Dharti Aaba Tribal Film Festival.

institutions.name: Tata Steel Foundation: Samvaad and Samuday Ke Saath
institutions.role: The company's foundation co-produced the animated Mundari Srishtikatha, runs Samvaad, its annual tribal conclave, and since 2015 the Samuday Ke Saath film programme, which screened Naachi Se Baanchi at IIM Ranchi in 2023. Tapu Rajee was shown in Jamshedpur at Tata's invitation.

institutions.name: PRADAN
institutions.city: New Delhi (head office); field teams across Jharkhand
institutions.role: The development organisation commissioned Akhra's Ek Ropa Dhaan, made Lac Ke Hazar Rang, and keeps a public Knowledge Repository of training and documentary films on agriculture, forest produce, and women's collectives.

institutions.name: Films Division of India
institutions.role: The state documentary body financed Naachi Se Baanchi, Akhra's film on Ram Dayal Munda, through a grant the collective sought and won.

institutions.name: Public Service Broadcasting Trust, with Doordarshan
institutions.role: Produced Shriprakash's Buru Gaara, Eer, and Hul Sengal Aguwa, and Biju Toppo's The Hunt and Jharia, for broadcast.

institutions.name: ActionAid
institutions.role: Funded K. P. Sasi's song-film Gaon Chhodab Nahi, which Akhra carried hand to hand.

institutions.name: Azim Premji University, Centre for Local Democracy
institutions.role: With Gram Swashasan Abhiyan, published Akhra's Gram Sabha ki Kahani films and podcasts.

offmap_institutions.name: Adivasi-Koordination in Deutschland
offmap_institutions.role: Partnered with Akhra on Accumulated Injustice, on the Rourkela steel plant.

offmap_institutions.name: UCLA Library, Los Angeles
offmap_institutions.role: Holds twelve Akhra films for the university's students and researchers, and is where several links on this map lead.

films.title: Ayangraji
films.creator: Arpit Gaind (director, editor)
films.description: An alternative agriculture and rice cultivation initiative in Radidih, following efforts to build community-supported markets and entrepreneurship opportunities for Adivasi people in the region.

films.title: Envisioning Development Practice
films.creator: Arpit Gaind (director, producer, editor)
films.description: Three practices across the Adivasi belt, each built by practitioners who arrived as students and stayed: Eka Nari Sangathan, Chinhari, and organic agriculture at Ayangraji. There is no narration; the speaking belongs to the people in the situation.

films.title: Chinhari: The Young India
films.creator: Arpit Gaind (director, producer)
films.description: Follows Chinhari, a collective of Adivasi youth in Dhamtari, centering on young women practicing agriculture and forming care groups within the collective.

films.title: Inoculating Lac
films.creator: Arpit Gaind (cinematographer, editor); produced by the Centre for Development Practice, Ambedkar University Delhi
films.description: Lac cultivation and livelihoods in Bhanupratappur, following the inoculation process at the center of the region's lac economy.

films.title: Jaha Chhiti Ladi Hathi Se
films.creator: AKHRA
films.description: About Indigenous peoples' struggle against bauxite mining. Full film on AKHRA's official channel.

films.title: Ek Hadsa Aur Bhi (Yet Another Accident)
films.creator: AKHRA; credited to Biju Toppo and Sunil Minj
films.description: On the Kutku-Mandal Dam incident in Palamu, when a closed sluice gate flooded some thirty-two villages. Full film on AKHRA's official channel.

films.title: Development Flows from the Barrel of the Gun (Vikas Bandook Ki Nal Se)
films.creator: Biju Toppo and Meghnath (AKHRA)
films.description: About the violation of Indigenous people's human rights through development projects, following resistance at Kashipur, Koel Karo, Nagarnar, and elsewhere. Awarded at Film South Asia 2004 and Vatavaran 2005. A German version was also made. No public stream; available to researchers through UCLA Library, or on request from AKHRA.

films.title: Accumulated Injustice
films.creator: AKHRA, with Adivasi-Koordination in Germany
films.description: Adivasi people's living conditions on the dark side of the Rourkela Steel Plant. Full film on AKHRA's official channel.

films.title: Naachi Se Baanchi
films.creator: Biju Toppo and Meghnath (AKHRA); produced by Films Division
films.description: On the life and work of Dr. Ramdayal Munda, a leading Adivasi intellectual of the Jharkhand movement. Rajat Kamal, 65th National Film Awards. Only an excerpt is public.

films.title: We Do Not Need Dust of Development
films.creator: Biju Toppo and Meghnath (AKHRA)
films.description: A debate on how environmental and public development might reach “the last person of the village” after mineral exploitation. Full film on AKHRA's official channel.

films.title: Jaadui Machchi
films.creator: Ektara Collective
films.description: A Hindi short by Ektara Collective. Full film on Ektara's official channel.

films.title: Turup (Checkmate)
films.creator: Ektara Collective
films.description: A neighbourhood chess game becomes a way into caste, class, religion, and gender through three women's lives, against rising fundamentalism. Premiered at the 19th Jio MAMI Mumbai Film Festival.

films.title: Gram Sabha ki Kahani: A Local Democracy Narrative Exercise
films.creator: Akhra Ranchi, for Gram Swashasan Abhiyan; Centre for Local Democracy, Azim Premji University
films.description: Short films and podcasts from villages in Jharkhand on how Gram Sabhas work in practice: forest rights at Baranga Munda Tola, women's participation, youth leadership, drinking water and the COVID response.

films.title: Ek Ropa Dhaan
films.creator: Meghnath Bhattacharya and Biju Toppo, for PRADAN
films.description: A film on the System of Rice Intensification (SRI) for paddy cultivation, made for PRADAN with support from the Aga Khan Foundation and the European Union. The English version is also on PRADAN's channel.

films.title: In Search of Ajantrik
films.creator: Meghnath
films.description: A filmmaker returns to the Jharkhand locations of Ritwik Ghatak's Ajantrik to ask why Ghatak chose the region and how the film pictured Adivasi life. International premiere at the Kolkata People's Film Festival.

films.title: Lac Ke Hazar Rang
films.creator: PRADAN
films.description: A film on promoting lac cultivation and developing lac as a sector. The English version is titled Lacquered Dreams.

films.title: Guftagoo with Ranendra
films.creator: Sansad TV (Guftagoo series)
films.description: An episode of the interview series Guftagoo with Ranendra, novelist and former director of the Tribal Welfare Research Institute in Ranchi, published on Sansad TV's channel.

films.title: Rat Trap
films.creator: Rupesh Kr Sahu (script, editing, direction); produced by Meghnath and Biju Toppo, AKHRA
films.description: The daily lives of rat-hole coal miners in Jharkhand, who risk their lives for a livelihood, whose accidents often go unreported, and who, when a mine collapses, cannot openly claim the bodies of those they lose.

films.title: Kora Rajee
films.creator: Biju Toppo (director); Meghnath (producer), AKHRA
films.description: A documentary on the struggles of migrants from Jharkhand working in the tea gardens of North Bengal and Assam.
films.beyond: Tea gardens of North Bengal and Assam

points.name: Tea gardens, Jalpaiguri district, North Bengal

films.title: Loha Garam Hai (Iron Is Hot)
films.creator: Biju Toppo and Meghnath, AKHRA
films.description: The lives of people surviving alongside the sponge iron industry in Jharkhand, and its effects on air, health, and land.

films.title: Gadi Lohardaga Mail
films.creator: Biju Toppo and Meghnath, AKHRA
films.description: Nostalgic Nagpuri folk songs performed on the narrow-gauge Lohardaga passenger train, sketching the social life of the district it ran through. Catalogued at UCLA under the title Gari Lohardaga Mela.

films.title: Sohrai
films.creator: Biju Toppo and Meghnath, AKHRA; produced for the Dr. Ramdayal Munda Tribal Welfare Research Institute
films.description: The Santhal festival of Sohrai, celebrated in Kartik, and the place of cattle in the shift from foraging to agriculture.

films.title: Karama
films.creator: Biju Toppo (director), AKHRA
films.description: Karam, one of Jharkhand's major festivals, in which nature is worshipped for a good harvest and for the wellbeing of people and animals.

films.title: Srishtikatha: Stories of Creation
films.creator: AKHRA; stories told by Ramdayal Munda; animation and direction by Tuhin Paul; produced by Meghnath
films.description: Animated Munda creation stories, the creation of the earth and of day and night by Singbonga, as told by Ramdayal Munda, made so that children can hear the stories their elders once told.

films.title: Eka Nari Sangathan
films.creator: Arpit Gaind (editor, producer), with Bhavya Chitranshi, Ashutosh Kumar, and Eka Nari Sangathan
films.description: On Eka Nari Sangathan, a single women's association begun by Bhavya Chitranshi and the women of the sangathan. More than an economic self-help group, it is a space where women named “single” for one reason or another share work, labour, and belonging, and shape identities and futures of their own: their aspirations, anxieties, community, and solidarity with one another.

films.title: Addo Miyad Ulgulan (Another Revolt / Ek aur Ulgulan)
films.creator: Shriprakash, Kritika
films.description: On Adivasi opposition to the Koel Karo hydroelectric project in Jharkhand. The uploaded version adds four minutes of footage of the 2001 killings.

films.title: Buddha Weeps in Jadugoda (Ragi: Kana: Ko Bonga Buru)
films.creator: Shriprakash, Kritika
films.description: On the harm to Adivasi health and land from uranium mining and tailings by the Uranium Corporation of India at Jadugoda. It won the Grand Prize at the Earth Vision Tokyo Global Environmental Film Festival.

films.title: Buru Sengal (The Fire Within)
films.creator: Shriprakash, Kritika
films.description: A documentary by Shriprakash; only a five-minute excerpt is public, on the Kritika channel.

films.title: Buru Gaara (Pahari Nadi)
films.creator: Shriprakash; produced by PSBT with Doordarshan
films.description: Two Adivasi women in Jharkhand, the journalist Dayamani Barla and the poet Nirmala Putul, assert identity through writing. Best Film on Social Issues, non-feature section, 56th National Film Awards.

films.title: Jadugoda: The Black Magic
films.creator: Shriprakash, Kritika
films.description: A short film on uranium mining and radiation at Jadugoda.

films.title: Eer... Stories in Stone
films.creator: Shriprakash; produced by PSBT
films.description: Tribal history, erased from mainstream accounts, read in the stone monuments that record it.

films.title: Hul Sengal Aguwa (Unsung Heroes of Hul)
films.creator: Shriprakash; produced by PSBT
films.description: Retraces the memory of two Indigenous people's movements, and of the films made about them.

films.title: Nabikei (Footprint)
films.creator: Shriprakash
films.description: The legacy of uranium mining for the Diné, Laguna, and Acoma nations, with some five thousand abandoned mines, set in parallel with Jadugoda. Screened at the International Uranium Film Festival, American Southwest, 2018. No public stream.
films.beyond: Diné, Laguna, and Acoma lands, US Southwest

films.title: Congo, The Blood in Our Pocket!
films.creator: Shriprakash, Kritika
films.description: On coltan and other mineral extraction in the Congo, and who bears its cost.

films.title: Keemat Chukati Zindagi
films.creator: Shriprakash
films.description: On the poet and people's leader Mahendra Singh, killed in 2005, made over thirteen years. Screened in competition at the 10th Chennai International Documentary and Short Film Festival, 2022. No public stream.

films.title: Tapu Rajee (Island Story)
films.creator: Biju Toppo; Dr. Ram Dayal Munda Tribal Welfare Research Institute
films.description: The people the map cannot hold: Oraon and Munda migrants settled in the Andaman Islands, outside the protected territory and absent from the list of the place they live. Screened in Jamshedpur and, in 2026, in Bangalore.
films.beyond: Andaman Islands: Oraon and Munda migrants who seek Scheduled Tribe listing in relation to Jharkhand under Article 342

points.name: South Andaman district, Andaman and Nicobar Islands

films.title: Gaon Chhodab Nahi
films.creator: K. P. Sasi (dir.), lyrics Meghnath; ActionAid; circulated by AKHRA
films.description: A song-film on displacement and migration, carried hand to hand on VCD and later online: we will not leave the village.

movements.name: Santal Hul
movements.what: The Santal rising against moneylenders, landlords, and the Company state in the Damin-i-koh and Santal Parganas.

movements.name: Birsa Munda's Ulgulan
movements.what: The Munda rising led by Birsa Munda against dikus and the colonial land settlement; the origin of the khuntkatti protections later written into the 1908 Tenancy Act.

movements.name: Koel Karo anti-dam movement
movements.what: Three decades of refusal to let the Koel and Karo rivers be dammed; police fired on protesters at Tapkara in February 2001.

movements.name: Against bauxite mining on the plateau
movements.what: Forest villages against bauxite leases on the plateau, filmed by Akhra as an ant fighting an elephant.

movements.name: Jadugoda against uranium
movements.what: Villages around the Uranium Corporation of India's mines and tailings ponds organise against radiation harm to health and land.

movements.name: Kutku-Mandal dam
movements.what: A closed sluice gate on the North Koel flooded some thirty-two villages.

movements.name: Against sponge-iron pollution
movements.what: People living beside the sponge-iron belt contest the dust and heat on air, health, and fields.

movements.name: Pathalgadi
movements.what: Villages raise inscribed stone slabs asserting Fifth Schedule provisions and gram sabha self-rule; more than ten thousand people named in sedition cases, withdrawn in December 2019.

movements.name: Jharkhand movement
movements.what: The long movement for a separate state, won in November 2000; Ram Dayal Munda among its intellectuals.
